question: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECT?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Non-metal – Lead**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lead (Pb): **

 
 
• Lead has an atomic number of 82 and an atomic mass of approximately 207.2 u (atomic mass units).
 
• It is a heavy metal that is dense, soft, and highly malleable, with a bluish-gray color.
 
• Lead is commonly used in batteries, radiation shielding, and certain types of glass and pigments.
 
• However, due to its toxicity, its use in household products like paints and pipes has significantly decreased to prevent lead poisoning.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zinc (Zn):**

 
 
• Zinc has an atomic number of 30 and an atomic mass of about 65.38 u.
 
• It is a bluish-white, lustrous metal that is brittle at room temperature but malleable when heated.
 
• Zinc is widely used for galvanizing iron and steel to prevent rusting, as well as in alloys such as brass.
 
• It is also an essential micronutrient in the human diet, crucial for immune function, wound healing, and DNA synthesis.
 
 
 
• **Platinum (Pt):**
 
 
• Platinum has an atomic number of 78 and an atomic mass of approximately 195.08 u.
 
• It is a dense, malleable, and highly unreactive metal with a silvery-white appearance.
 
• Platinum is extensively used in catalytic converters, laboratory equipment, electrical contacts, and jewelry.
 
• Its resistance to corrosion makes it valuable in chemical and industrial applications, and it also plays a role in some medical treatments and devices.
 
 
 
• **Iron (Fe):**
 
 
• Iron has an atomic number of 26 and an atomic mass of about 55.85 u.
 
• It is a silvery-gray metal that is prone to rusting when exposed to moisture and oxygen.
 
• Iron is the most widely used metal, primarily in the form of steel, due to its strength and affordability.
 
• It is also a crucial element in biology, forming part of hemoglobin, the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout the body.
 
• Iron deficiency can lead to anemia, a condition characterized by fatigue and weakness
